message: Crisp is a shared inbox for storefront chat and email with an AI Agent that can be trained on your store's content and connected to Shopify order data to answer common pre- and post-purchase questions before handing a conversation to a human. The current product fit is partial or carries unresolved scope limits. Draft only around the addressed needs and the dossier's scope limits. No companies have been qualified; verify recipient fit before outreach.
